name: Minnesofa Furniture
description: Minnesofa was founded by Max Bjorklund and Luke Schultz in May 2022. The company began by refurbishing used furniture in a garage, where their passion for business and furniture flourished. This inspired a vision to expand and source a diverse range of new furniture with the aim of opening a retail store. Just one year later, they proudly accomplished this goal. Minnesofa currently has a location in Moorhead MN and just launched their new store in Excelsior MN!

description: Mr. Conway also actively contributes to research, development and design activities. From 2013 to 2018, Mr. Conway served as President of BCG Technologies and Minnesota Medical. From 1979 to 1988, he was President of Arcon Corp., a company that he co-founded with Philip J Conway. Prior to founding Arcon, Mr. Conway worked for 12 years for International Business Machines Corp. in various research and development capacities.
